recipe.name: preservationstudio Django
bootstrap: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && DJANGO_DEBUG=1 .venv/bin/python manage.py migrate --noinput
recipe.notes: Production site (client: Preservation Studio / Asher Cano) on Railway + Postgres. Local runs SQLite with DJANGO_DEBUG=1; tests pin HTTP_HOST=localhost (in ALLOWED_HOSTS default). Suite: 38 tests incl. a real ~4MB photo-upload regression (DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE=12MB).
evidence: deployed 2e2eb71: HSTS max-age=15552000 live, all 10 pages 200, admin gated
